description: Where to farm an item: ranks every stage of a game server that drops it, with sanity per item, drop rate (items per run), runs (times) and quantity. Use it for any question about where to get an item, its best or most efficient stage, or which of several stages to run for it: one call ranks every stage, so don't look stages up one by one with get_stage_drops (only a named stage left out of the top_n returned). By default the stages open now that still drop it, lowest sanity per item first; stages of fewer than 100 runs (lowSample) rank after the others, gachas and the recruitment (no sanity cost) last. sort_by=drop_rate ranks by rate instead; include_closed=true adds past events and ended drops. item_id takes the item's name in any language; search_items first only when the name may mean several items.

include_closed.description: false (default): only the stages open on the server now that still drop the item. true: also the stages of past events and the drops that ended, for history.

item_id.description: Item ID, from search_items: 30012. A name or alias that only one item has works too: 固源岩, Orirock Cube

lang.description: Language of the names in the result: the language the user writes in, zh, en, ja or ko (en for other languages, and if omitted).

server.description: Game server the user plays on: CN (mainland China: 国服, 官服, B服), US (global, English: 国际服, 美服), JP (日服) or KR (韩服). Stages, events and drop rates differ by server. Use the server the user named or the conversation makes clear; a user writing Chinese, Japanese or Korean most likely plays CN, JP or KR. If you can't tell, ask the user which server they play on before calling. Name the server in your answer.

sort_by.description: sanity_per_item (default): the least sanity per item first. drop_rate: the most items per run first.

top_n.description: Most stages to return, 1 to 100. Default 10.

name: get_item_drop_rates

dataAsOf.description: When the drop data was calculated, RFC 3339 in UTC

name.description: Name in the language asked for

pageUrl.description: Page of the drop rates of the item on the server on Penguin Statistics; null if there is none

rows.description: The stages, in the order of sortBy

apCost.description: Sanity cost of a run; null without one (gachas, the recruitment)

code.description: Code in the language asked for

dropsNow.description: Whether the stage is open now and still drops the item (end is null or later than now): the rows of the default result

end.description: End of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC; null while it goes on

lowSample.description: Whether the rate is of fewer than 100 runs, and so noisy

openNow.description: Whether the stage is open on the server now, by the open and close times of the stage and its zone; supply and chip stages (zoneType WEEKLY) count as open every day, as their weekday rotation is not tracked

pageUrl.description: Page of the drops of the stage on the server on Penguin Statistics; null if there is none

start.description: Start of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC

zoneName.description: Name of the zone in the language asked for

attribution.description: The credit to give wherever this data is used

url.description: The page of this data on Penguin Statistics, or its home page

totalStages.description: Stages that drop the item now (dropsNow), or all with includeClosed

title: Item drop rates
